sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Seamless Death (无间死环) is a dual-wielded blade pair in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Hurlable ring blades - the only dual-wield entry whose ranged option is the weapon itself rather than a Phantom Edge.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Seamless Death (无间死环) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Dual-wield. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Seamless Death (无间死环) has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Ring blades can be hurled.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Mountain of Imprisonment, The Lady's Shrine.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Seamless Death (无间死环) by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
